name: T&R Tooling, LLC - Plastic Injection Molding Service Texas
old_description: T&R Tooling delivers end-to-end precision tooling and plastic injection molding solutions that let you manufacture with confidence — from design and production, to stocking and delivery.
about:
T&R Tooling, LLC operates from a 40,000-square-foot facility in Valley View, Texas. The company was founded by Tom and Ronney, two toolmakers who began with a small backyard shop in nearby Krum. Their partnership grew from a handshake and a shared belief that they could better serve customers together. The business remains family-owned.

The shop provides end-to-end plastic injection molding and custom tooling. Services span mold design and construction (both in-house and offshore), mold repair, optimization, and transfer, as well as low- to high-volume injection molding. Prototyping capabilities include 3D printing and CNC machining. Post-molding operations cover first-article inspection, assembly, packaging, hot-stamping, and inventory stocking programs. The facility houses 14 injection molding machines, eight machining centers, and an assembly department, supported by SolidWorks, Mastercam, and Fusion 360.

Customers come from aerospace, automotive, robotics, and other industrial sectors. Named references include Pinnacle Safety Products (safety equipment), North Texas Plastics, and Displays by Martin Paul, Inc. (display manufacturing).

The founders started T&R Tooling to deliver a seamless, stress-free experience from design to delivery. The company emphasizes guaranteed mold ownership, on-time delivery, proactive communication, and a craftsmanship-driven culture.
